items.question: Under what condition are beings tormented within eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams?
premises: A fixed count of womb-diagrams is specified here.
Beings are said to occupy those womb-diagrams in this context.
A state of torment is attributed to those beings.
items.inference: Beings are tormented while situated in the eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.
uncertainties: The agent or cause of torment is not specified by this verse alone.
items.plain_english: In the eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams, beings are tormented.
